steps.caption: Search Console
steps.narration: This is Search Console. It brings your Google search clicks and indexing checks into ConstructHUB.

steps.caption: Every property, listed
steps.narration: Every property your account can open is listed. Sync imports its data in the background.

steps.caption: Open a property
steps.narration: The list refreshes every hour. Open this roofing company's property.

steps.caption: Clicks, impressions, CTR, position
steps.narration: The tiles total clicks, impressions, click-through rate and average position for the dates you pick.

steps.caption: Click a bar
steps.narration: Click any bar in the daily clicks chart.

steps.caption: Its date and value
steps.narration: Its date and its clicks are pinned up here.

steps.caption: Break it down
steps.narration: Break the report down by query, page, device or country. Here, one row per search.

steps.caption: Most clicks first
steps.narration: Click the Clicks heading, and the searches with the most clicks come first.

steps.caption: Indexing at a glance
steps.narration: Each inspected page shows Google's verdict, and this line totals them: nine pass, one fails.

steps.caption: Add a page
steps.narration: To check a page, type its address under the property.

steps.caption: Review before queuing
steps.narration: You see each property and address before anything is queued.

steps.caption: Your rows stay
steps.narration: Close it, and your rows stay where they were.

steps.selector: div:has(> div > p:has-text("Google Search Console · property totals")) >> nth=-1
steps.caption: Last 30 days, per location
steps.narration: A linked location's Insights tab shows its property's last 30 days.

steps.caption: Menu: Search Console
steps.narration: You'll find Search Console in the menu on the left, under Tools.

youtube.title: Search Console in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of Search Console in ConstructHUB: see every Google Search Console property in one list, read clicks, impressions, click-through rate and position, sort searches by clicks, review URL inspections before they are queued, and see each linked location's last 30 days.
